d:
COP31 climate summit finally ended, but it did so without its most important outcome: a common agreement on how countries should step up their fight against global warming. The talks ran two days beyond their scheduled November 20 deadline, becoming the longest UN climate summit on record. Yet, countries could not agree on a final deal, after deep divisions emerged over fossil fuels, climate finance and the future of carbon capture technology. Samah Qundeel explains the reason for the failure and what comes next.
